name: Splash
description: Splash is an event marketing platform for designing, promoting and measuring in-person, virtual and hybrid events. Teams use it to create branded event pages, manage invitations and registration, coordinate programs, communicate with guests and analyze event performance.
agentUseSummary: Connect a Customer Success-issued Splash API client and dedicated customer API user through Railway's encrypted credential boundary, then let selected agents list page-one event summaries or inspect one exact event without guest or contact data.

credentialRequirements.name: SPLASH_CLIENT_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Splash API client ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Obtain the customer-specific client from Splash Customer Success.

credentialRequirements.name: SPLASH_CLIENT_SECRET
credentialRequirements.label: Splash API client secret
credentialRequirements.helpText: Store the issued client secret encrypted.

credentialRequirements.name: SPLASH_API_USERNAME
credentialRequirements.label: Splash API username
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use a dedicated customer-controlled API user email.

credentialRequirements.name: SPLASH_API_PASSWORD
credentialRequirements.label: Splash API user password
credentialRequirements.helpText: Splash's documented password grant requires this encrypted credential.

capabilities.label: Read event metadata
capabilities.description: List bounded Splash event summaries and inspect one exact event without guest or contact data.

allowed.label: List events
allowed.description: List at most twenty-five Splash event summaries from page one.

allowed.label: Read an event
allowed.description: Read one exact numeric Splash event metadata summary.

blocked.label: Block people data
blocked.description: Guests, contacts, email, RSVP answers, QR codes, campaigns, unsubscribe state and attendee analytics are not exposed.

blocked.label: Block mutations
blocked.description: Event, workflow, guest, contact, unsubscribe, team and CRM event writes are not exposed.

blocked.label: Block raw API
blocked.description: Arbitrary view groups, filters, pages, bulk operations and raw responses are not exposed.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Bounded event metadata reads run directly; guest/contact data, writes, bulk and raw API access remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The same selected read surface runs without Relay per-action approval; credential ownership, fixed origin, bounds, redaction and provider authority still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts two typed Splash event reads and sends encrypted customer credentials only to the fixed token endpoint.
Relay mounts two typed Splash event reads and sends encrypted customer credentials only to the fixed token endpoint.

providerSetup.blocker: Splash Customer Success must issue the customer API client, and a dedicated customer-controlled API username/password is required for the documented password grant.
providerSetup.nextAction: In the separate provider-console task, obtain the client securely from Splash Customer Success, provision a dedicated least-authority API user under the customer's MFA/account policy, store both secrets encrypted, validate the token exchange and two reads, rotate/revoke credentials provider-side, and confirm post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Splash API v2.2 documents Customer Success-issued Client ID/secret, username/password token exchange with scope user, eight-hour access tokens, refresh tokens, fixed token/API origins, GET /events with explicit limit/page, and GET /events/{id}.
Splash describes its API and HTTP/webhook integrations as ways to connect event data with customer technology.
Splash describes event marketing, branded event experiences, registration and event analytics product capabilities.
